question: In India, subject to the provisions of article 333, the Legislative Assembly of each State shall consist of not more than __________ members.
solution:
The correct answer is __**five hundred**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Constitution of India, the Legislative Assembly of each State shall consist of not more than **five hundred** members.
 
• This provision ensures that there is a limit to the number of representatives in the legislative assembly, promoting effective governance and management.
 
• Article 333 allows for the representation of the Anglo-Indian community in the legislative assemblies by nomination, if the President feels that the community is not adequately represented.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 26th November 1949 and came into effect on 26th January 1950.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the longest written constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.
 
• The Seventh Schedule of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the Union, State, and Concurrent lists.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in Article 368.
 
• The Legislative Assembly serves as the lower house of the state legislature in India, with the Vidhan Parishad (Legislative Council) serving as the upper house in some states.
